_readme: Single source of truth for the WooCommerce catalog. seed.php imports it. 'supplier' maps each product to the Supliful catalog item. 'label_verified: false' means doses/counts must be checked against the supplier's real label before launch. 'image' files live in wordpress/themes/evenly/assets/img/.

products.name: Evenly Unwind: Magnesium Glycinate
products.tagline: The gentle magnesium for tight muscles, cramps and a busy brain at night.
products.short: Highly absorbable magnesium glycinate that supports muscle relaxation, menstrual comfort and restful sleep. Gentle on the stomach, no laxative effect.*
products.description:
If your body feels tense at night (tight shoulders, restless legs, cramping that won't let go), magnesium is often the first thing to look at. Many US women don't get enough from food, and needs can run higher around your period.

We use magnesium glycinate, the form bound to the amino acid glycine. It's well absorbed and easy on digestion, unlike magnesium oxide, the cheap form that sends people to the bathroom. Glycine itself supports a calm transition to sleep.

Take it in the evening as your wind-down ritual, and keep taking it through your cycle.
benefits: Supports muscle relaxation, including occasional menstrual cramping*
Supports a calm mood and restful sleep*
Gentle, non-laxative form
products.how_to_use: Take 2 capsules with water 30–60 minutes before bed. Around your period, many women take it every day of the cycle.
ingredients: Supports muscle relaxation and nervous-system calm
products.warnings: Do not exceed the recommended dose. If you have kidney disease, are pregnant or nursing, or take antibiotics, bisphosphonates or blood-pressure medication, ask your doctor before use. Keep out of reach of children.
faq: Will magnesium glycinate make me groggy?
It isn't a sedative. Most people describe it as feeling physically "unwound" rather than drugged, and wake up clear.
Can I take it for period cramps?
Magnesium supports normal muscle relaxation, and many women take it daily through their cycle for comfort.* If cramps are severe or getting worse, see your doctor.
Can I take it with Evenly Sleep?
Yes. That pairing is The Sleep Stack bundle.

products.name: Evenly Sleep: Low-Dose Sleep Formula
products.tagline: Fall asleep faster and wake up clear, not foggy.
products.short: A low-dose melatonin formula with calming botanicals to help you fall asleep and stay asleep, without the next-morning fog.*
products.description:
Most drugstore melatonin comes in 5–10 mg doses, far more than research suggests most people need. That's a big reason people wake up groggy and give up on it.

Evenly Sleep keeps melatonin low and pairs it with gentle calming botanicals. It's built for the nights you lie there with your mind racing, and for the 3 a.m. wake-ups.
benefits: Helps you fall asleep faster*
Supports staying asleep through the night*
Low dose, designed to avoid morning grogginess
products.how_to_use: Take 1 serving 30 minutes before bed. Not for daily use longer than recommended on the label. Do not drive after taking.
ingredients: Signals to your body that it's time to sleep
products.warnings: For adults 18+. Do not take if pregnant, nursing, or trying to conceive. Ask your doctor before use if you take sedatives, antidepressants, blood thinners, immunosuppressants, diabetes or blood-pressure medication, or have an autoimmune or seizure condition. May cause drowsiness. Do not drive or operate machinery after use.
faq: Is it habit-forming?
Melatonin isn't considered habit-forming, and we keep the dose low on purpose. Use it for occasional sleeplessness, along with good wind-down habits.
Why low-dose?
More melatonin isn't better. Lower doses are associated with less next-day grogginess.

products.name: Evenly Cycle: Women's Balance Formula
products.tagline: Chasteberry, black cohosh and dong quai for a calmer cycle.
products.short: A traditional botanical formula with chasteberry (vitex), black cohosh and dong quai to support hormonal balance and menstrual comfort, every day of your cycle.*
products.description:
PMS can feel like a monthly tax: mood swings, tender breasts, bloating, cramps, and the feeling that your body isn't on your side for a week.

Evenly Cycle combines botanicals women have used for generations. Chasteberry (vitex) is one of the most studied herbs for premenstrual comfort. Black cohosh, dong quai, red clover and sage round out the blend. It isn't a painkiller you grab on day one. It's a daily formula that builds over 2–3 cycles.
benefits: Supports hormonal balance throughout the cycle*
Helps ease occasional PMS discomfort, including mood changes and breast tenderness*
Daily formula that builds over 2–3 cycles
products.how_to_use: Take 2 capsules daily with food. Give it 2–3 full cycles to judge how it works for you.
ingredients: The most-studied herb for premenstrual comfort
Traditionally used for female hormonal balance
Traditionally used in women's herbal formulas
products.warnings: Do not use if pregnant, nursing or trying to conceive, or if you use hormonal birth control or hormone therapy. Do not use if you have, or have had, a hormone-sensitive condition (such as breast, uterine or ovarian cancer, endometriosis or fibroids), liver disease, or a bleeding disorder, or if you take blood thinners. Ask your doctor before use. Stop and see a doctor if you have abdominal pain, dark urine or yellowing of the skin or eyes.
faq: How fast does it work?
Botanical cycle formulas work gradually. Most women judge it after 2–3 full cycles of daily use.*
Can I take it on birth control?
No. Please don't combine it with hormonal birth control or hormone therapy without your doctor's OK.
Is this for menopause?
It's formulated for menstrual-cycle support. If you're in perimenopause, talk to your doctor about what fits.

products.name: Evenly Digest: Digestive Enzymes
products.tagline: Take it with your first bite, so lunch doesn't come back at 3 p.m.
products.short: A broad-spectrum digestive enzyme blend taken with meals to help break down food and relieve occasional gas and bloating.*
products.description:
You eat a normal lunch, and by mid-afternoon your waistband is fighting you. Often the problem is food that isn't fully broken down, so it ferments into gas instead.

Evenly Digest delivers a full-spectrum enzyme blend (Makzyme-Pro) with your meal to help break down protein, fats and carbohydrates. Many women find it especially useful in the bloated days before their period.
benefits: Helps break down protein, fats and carbohydrates*
Helps relieve occasional gas and bloating after meals*
Supports comfortable digestion, including pre-period bloating*
products.how_to_use: Take 1 capsule with the first bite of your two largest meals.
products.warnings: Ask your doctor before use if you are pregnant or nursing, take blood thinners, or have a stomach ulcer or digestive condition. Discontinue if you experience discomfort.
faq: When do I take it?
Right as you start eating. Enzymes need to meet the food.
Will it help with period bloating?
Pre-period bloating is partly water retention and partly slower digestion. Evenly Digest supports the digestion side.*

products.name: Evenly Flora: Probiotic 40 Billion
products.tagline: 40 billion CFU with prebiotics, for a calmer, more regular gut.
products.short: A daily probiotic with 40 billion CFU plus prebiotic fiber to support a balanced gut, regularity and digestive comfort.*
products.description:
Antibiotics, stress, travel, takeout and hormonal shifts can all throw your gut bacteria off balance, and you feel it as bloating and irregularity.

Evenly Flora delivers 40 billion CFU across well-studied strains, plus FOS prebiotic fiber that feeds them.
benefits: Supports a balanced gut microbiome*
Supports regularity and digestive comfort*
Includes prebiotic fiber (FOS)
products.how_to_use: Take 2 capsules daily with water, ideally in the morning.
ingredients: Prebiotic fiber that feeds good bacteria
products.warnings: Ask your doctor before use if you are immunocompromised, critically ill, pregnant or nursing. Mild gas in the first days is common as your gut adjusts.
faq: Do I need to refrigerate it?
Follow the storage directions on the label. Keep it in a cool, dry place.
I feel a bit gassy the first week. Normal?
Yes, that's common while your gut adjusts. It usually settles within a week or two.

products.name: Evenly Restore: L-Glutamine Powder
products.tagline: Unflavored gut-lining support you stir into evening tea.
products.short: Pure, unflavored L-glutamine powder to support a healthy intestinal lining while your body does its overnight repair work.*
products.description:
Your gut does a lot of its maintenance overnight. L-glutamine is the main fuel for the cells that line your intestines.

One scoop in water or herbal tea in the evening: no taste, no fuss.
benefits: Supports a healthy intestinal lining*
Supports digestive comfort*
Unflavored, mixes into any drink
products.how_to_use: Mix 1 scoop (3.3 g) into water or herbal tea once daily, in the evening.
ingredients: Fuel for the cells lining the gut
products.warnings: Do not use if you have liver or kidney disease, or a history of seizures or bipolar disorder, unless your doctor approves. Ask your doctor before use if pregnant or nursing.
faq: Does it taste like anything?
It's unflavored. Most people don't notice it in tea or water.

products.name: Evenly Calm: Ashwagandha
products.tagline: Take the edge off busy days, so you're not still wound up at bedtime.
products.short: KSM-66 ashwagandha, the most-studied adaptogen for everyday stress, to support calm focus by day and an easier wind-down at night.*
products.description: Bad nights often start at noon: the inbox, the kids, the cortisol spike that never quite comes down. Evenly Calm uses KSM-66 ashwagandha root extract to help your body handle everyday stress, so your evening wind-down comes easier.
benefits: Helps the body adapt to everyday stress*
Supports a calm, balanced mood*
Supports a healthy evening wind-down*
products.warnings: Do not use if pregnant or nursing. Ask your doctor before use if you have a thyroid, liver or autoimmune condition, or take thyroid medication, sedatives, immunosuppressants, diabetes or blood-pressure medication. Stop use if you notice signs of liver problems.
faq: Will it make me sleepy during the day?
Ashwagandha isn't a sedative. Most people feel steadier, not drowsy.
